name: Balochi

ancestors.notes: Iranian (Northwestern Iranian) — the classification node this language sits under, per Jahani & Korn (2009).

notes: Balochi (بلۏچی), Northwestern Iranian language of Balochistan (Pakistan, Iran, Afghanistan) and diaspora communities in the Gulf and East Africa; ~8 million speakers, a recognised regional/provincial language (Balochistan province, Pakistan) though without a single fully standardised orthography -- Eastern/Rakhshani, Coastal/Makrani and other varieties differ, and both Perso-Arabic (majority, Pakistan/Iran/Afghanistan) and Latin (diaspora, some Central Asian publications) scripts are in use. This spec covers the PERSO-ARABIC ('Balochi Standard Alphabet') rendering. GRAPHEME KEYS: the base is the Urdu/Persian Perso-Arabic letter inventory, EXTENDED with the same three retroflex letters Urdu borrows for its own retroflex series (ٹ /ʈ/, ڈ /ɖ/, ڑ /ɽ/ -- Balochi has a genuine retroflex series the way Urdu and Sindhi do, unlike Persian) plus ژ /ʒ/. Unlike `ur` (Urdu), this spec has NO aspirate/breathy digraph keys (ٹھ, بھ, ...): Balochi's phonemic aspiration contrast on voiceless stops (Jahani & Korn 2009) is NOT written in the standard orthography at all (the same base letter serves plain and aspirated /p t k tʃ/ and /pʰ tʰ kʰ tʃʰ/), so encoding it as a spelling distinction would be inventing graphemes the orthography does not have; this is a genuine, documented orthographic under-differentiation (AGENTS.md rule 4: describe the language honestly, do not chase accuracy with an unattested spelling split). Short vowel diacritics (fatha/kasra/damma) are frequently OMITTED in running Balochi text as in Persian/Urdu/Arabic more generally, so short /a i u/ are under-represented by this table; long vowels ا/آ, و, ی/ے are represented. Balochi ه(h) sometimes stands for word-final /aː/ as in Persian; both values kept. STRESS: no lexical stress distinguishing minimal pairs is described for Balochi in Jahani & Korn (2009) (stress is reported as largely predictable, final/on the last full syllable, and non-contrastive); left unencoded here -- a documented exemption. TIER: no WikiPron (or other registrable) gold exists for `bal` (checked against CUNY-CL/wikipron's scrape summary, 2026-08-03: zero rows), so `skeleton`, not `research`.
